Writing the module config and syncing the kernel…

One configuration drives both forms: the module (Zygisk / Zygisk Next, recommended) and the kernel (KernelSU with the XEChide patch, optional). The configuration is encrypted with Android Keystore, stored in app-private storage, and re-applied at boot; module-mode rule changes need a target app restart. The helper status only checks that the file is executable; it does not verify that the module or the kernel patch is loaded.
